text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho. Gold City was 
more focused than ever before, to the 
point where one would hesitate to even 
speak to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To seize the recognition she desired this 
time around— She headed out onto the field 
of battle.
